name: sort
alt: Content Sort: the waiting items in the white list down the left, newest first, a working paper chosen in blue; its card in the middle, and the decisions on the right: New research with the Working Paper subtype, ERC Newsletter only as a switch, Keep and next, Skip for now and Delete.

before.note: A row click scrolls the page; the shot starts at the top, the Sort and Finalize band in view.

pins.label: The item the card shows. Pick a row, or move with the up and down arrows
Type: what the item is. Pick one, then its subtype
Keep and next: keeps it and opens the next item. K does the same
Delete: takes it out of the queue. D does the same

name: send
alt: The decision column of an event's card: Event picked with its A&M chip, ERC Newsletter only switched on with the line Skips the Policy Exchange, then Keep and next, Skip for now and Delete.

pins.label: ERC event: anything the ERC hosts or co-hosts
A&M: an event on campus, another unit's
ERC Newsletter only: on, the item never reaches Publish

name: questions
alt: A card with questions: the Check the link note with Verify link, the Type label in orange with no type picked, and Keep and next grayed with Set a type first under it.

pins.label: Verify link: opens the page in a new tab
Type: its label stays orange until one is picked
Keep and next waits, and says what it needs

name: groups
alt: Sort scrolled to the foot of its list: a skipped item with its Skipped tag, then the Past group with Dismiss all and its dated items, then the Already live group with Dismiss all.

pins.label: Skipped: an item you parked. It waits under the new ones
Past: events and opportunities whose date or deadline has gone
Already live: links the Policy Exchange already has

name: finalize
alt: Content Sort's Finalize tab: Rewrite 2 descriptions at the top right, a report and an event under Needs a rewrite on the left, and the report's card with its Original text, Edit and Delete.

before.eval: fetch('/api/sheet', { method: 'PATCH', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ rows: [{ id: 'sbx_019', rewrite_checked: '', blurb: 'Half-day workshop pairing ERC researchers with district data leads to scope shared research questions for the spring. Space is limited and registration closes September 22.' }, { id: 'sbx_020', rewrite_checked: '', blurb: '' }] }) }).then(r => r.ok)
before.note: A Keep on an earlier capture stamps the sandbox's kept event and report as checked, and a Rewrite gives them its stand-in words; this puts both back as the sandbox starts, under Needs a rewrite with their own text as Original.

pins.label: Needs a rewrite: kept items still waiting for their description
Rewrite the descriptions: writes the ones still waiting
Original: the text it came with
Edit: write or fix the description by hand
